speaker: Amiya
content: You've held on for so long—

speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: (Panting heavily)

speaker: Amiya
content: But not any longer.

speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: (Panting heavily)

raw: Shadow swallows the figure up. Apparitions from the past pull him back into the fold.
content: Shadow swallows the figure up. Apparitions from the past pull him back into the fold.

raw: More of them emerge from the darkness.
content: More of them emerge from the darkness.

speaker: Amiya
content: Still not giving up?

speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: We have nothing left to 'give up'.

raw: [name="Amiya"]You could've attacked me together, but you didn't...
speaker: Amiya
content: You could've attacked me together, but you didn't...

raw: [name="Amiya"]I don't sense any anger, but you're all submerged in sorrow...
speaker: Amiya
content: I don't sense any anger, but you're all submerged in sorrow...

speaker: Amiya
content: You're different from that revenant.

raw: [name="Airship 'Apparition'"]We are not here to kill you.
speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: We are not here to kill you.

raw: [name="Airship 'Apparition'"]We are here only to witness her success.
speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: We are here only to witness her success.

speaker: Amiya
content: Sorry, but I can't stop here.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
Black waves ripple from Amiya, suppressing the shadows.
content: Black waves ripple from Amiya, suppressing the shadows.

raw: She advances slowly, ignoring the blades streaking past her.
content: She advances slowly, ignoring the blades streaking past her.

speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: 'King of Sarkaz'...

speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: You are her successor.

raw: The apparitions keep approaching Amiya, but are incessantly pushed away from her, falling back into the shadows.
content: The apparitions keep approaching Amiya, but are incessantly pushed away from her, falling back into the shadows.
Amiya continues forward.

speaker: Amiya
content: Doctor... Dr. Kal'tsit... Theresa...
She touches the shadow.

raw: She sees a completely crystallized door at the corridor's end, and a blade rushing toward her.
content: She sees a completely crystallized door at the corridor's end, and a blade rushing toward her.

raw: Shades of black coagulate in her palm, and she immediately catches the incoming blade...
content: Shades of black coagulate in her palm, and she immediately catches the incoming blade...
Catching inexhaustible sorrow.

raw: She sees the sorrow from the past—
content: She sees the sorrow from the past—

speaker: Babel Member
content: Her Highness... she's dead... How...?

speaker: Babel Member
content: We lost...?

raw: [name="Babel Member"]Her Highness... died because we failed our duty...
speaker: Babel Member
content: Her Highness... died because we failed our duty...

speaker: Dying Assassin
content: *cough*... *cough*...

speaker: Babel Member
content: You... you're still... alive...

raw: I can feel him gripping tightly on my collar.
content: I can feel him gripping tightly on my collar.

speaker: Dying Assassin
content: Her Highness... is dead?

raw: [name="Dying Assassin"]Our mission... is complete? It... is done...
speaker: Dying Assassin
content: Our mission... is complete? It... is done...

raw: [name="Dying Assassin"]Finish me off. Don't you want to... exact revenge for Her Highness?
speaker: Dying Assassin
content: Finish me off. Don't you want to... exact revenge for Her Highness?

raw: There's still that grenade in my chest pocket... that crazy girl threw it to me, telling me to protect Her Highness.
content: There's still that grenade in my chest pocket... that crazy girl threw it to me, telling me to protect Her Highness.
I just... have to—

raw: I don't know how long I spend hesitating.
content: I don't know how long I spend hesitating.

raw: But it is only when his hand droops down, and breathes his last...
content: But it is only when his hand droops down, and breathes his last...

raw: That I realize that crazy girl was right.
content: That I realize that crazy girl was right.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Trash. Coward.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Trash. Coward.

raw: I've already forgotten how long I spent wandering in the wastes after leaving Babel.
content: I've already forgotten how long I spent wandering in the wastes after leaving Babel.

raw: Drifters until we meet some Royal Court recruiters. They say Her Highness has returned, and stands together with Theresis...
content: Drifters until we meet some Royal Court recruiters. They say Her Highness has returned, and stands together with Theresis...

raw: We knew then where we should go.
content: We knew then where we should go.

raw: [name="Theresis"]You come here in anger and ask me why I spread falsehoods among our people.
speaker: Theresis
content: You come here in anger and ask me why I spread falsehoods among our people.

speaker: Theresis
content: Come up here, before me...

speaker: Theresis
content: And show me your wrath.

raw: The steps to Theresis number many, and the sovereigns of the Royal Court stare at me in indifference.
content: The steps to Theresis number many, and the sovereigns of the Royal Court stare at me in indifference.
But I do not stop.

raw: I am a coward no more. I will unleash my anger before Theresis, and then die by his blade.
content: I am a coward no more. I will unleash my anger before Theresis, and then die by his blade.

raw: I stand before him, but he does not greet me with his sword.
content: I stand before him, but he does not greet me with his sword.
Theresis only nods.

speaker: Theresis
content: Very good.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Keep your anger, but vent it somewhere else.
speaker: Theresis
content: Keep your anger, but vent it somewhere else.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Because what you've heard is no lie.
speaker: Theresis
content: Because what you've heard is no lie.

speaker: Theresa
content: You found me, children.

raw: I understood many things then. Her Highness died, but there she was, holding my hand.
content: I understood many things then. Her Highness died, but there she was, holding my hand.

raw: The truth hurt me more than the lies did.
content: The truth hurt me more than the lies did.

raw: The sorrow that spread from the depths of my heart destroyed my anger so easily.
content: The sorrow that spread from the depths of my heart destroyed my anger so easily.
Your Highness...

raw: The Highness we once swore to protect...
content: The Highness we once swore to protect...

speaker: Amiya
content: I... saw her...

speaker: Amiya
content: Through your eyes... your life—

raw: [name="Airship 'Apparition'"]Are they all dead? My only companions...
speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: Are they all dead? My only companions...

raw: [name="Airship 'Apparition'"]No matter, they only left before I did. At least they stayed true to their task, they died to protect Her Highness.
speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: No matter, they only left before I did. At least they stayed true to their task, they died to protect Her Highness.

speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: As will I, Amiya.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: *cough*...

raw: [name="Amiya"]All of you... you have my respect—
speaker: Amiya
content: All of you... you have my respect—

raw: [name="Airship 'Apparition'"]Our past is no more. We chose to collude with disgrace.
speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: Our past is no more. We chose to collude with disgrace.

raw: [name="Airship 'Apparition'"]We willingly abandoned everything—only by doing so can we stand before Her Highness with a clear conscience.
speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: We willingly abandoned everything—only by doing so can we stand before Her Highness with a clear conscience.

raw: [name="Airship 'Apparition'"]And that is why... we erased our names, and put on the clothes we once utterly detested.
speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: And that is why... we erased our names, and put on the clothes we once utterly detested.

raw: [name="Amiya"]I have my own people to protect too. I can't stop here.
speaker: Amiya
content: I have my own people to protect too. I can't stop here.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: *cough*...

raw: [name="Airship 'Apparition'"]Heh, you can try to stop Her Highness... only by defeating us.
speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: Heh, you can try to stop Her Highness... only by defeating us.

raw: [name="Airship 'Apparition'"]Even if I am the only one left.
speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: Even if I am the only one left.

speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: Your heart is going soft.

raw: [name="Airship 'Apparition'"]If you can't even face me and defeat me, what makes you think you can face Her Highness, 'King of Sarkaz'?!
speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: If you can't even face me and defeat me, what makes you think you can face Her Highness, 'King of Sarkaz'?!

raw: [name="Airship 'Apparition'"]You will eventually have to face your own fate.
speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: You will eventually have to face your own fate.

raw: [name="Amiya"]My mind was already made up the moment I stepped onto this airship.
speaker: Amiya
content: My mind was already made up the moment I stepped onto this airship.

speaker: Amiya
content: Your sorrow, the Sarkaz's sorrow...

speaker: Amiya
content: Should end.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
The apparition from the past finally falls back into the shadows.
content: The apparition from the past finally falls back into the shadows.

speaker: Airship 'Apparition'
content: *cough*... *cough*...

speaker: Amiya
content: Be at peace—

speaker: Amiya
content: Huh? That's a... grenade?!

raw: You said the Sarkaz will have a new future.
content: You said the Sarkaz will have a new future.

raw: We rotten souls are meant to be incinerated, so why not burn for the ideal you described to us?
content: We rotten souls are meant to be incinerated, so why not burn for the ideal you described to us?

raw: We failed Babel once, and it will not happen twice.
content: We failed Babel once, and it will not happen twice.
We shall protect you.
Death will witness our promise.

raw: This coward will not break their promise, Your Highness Theresa...
content: This coward will not break their promise, Your Highness Theresa...

raw: [name="W"]Who the hell's fooling around with my grenades?
speaker: W
content: Who the hell's fooling around with my grenades?

raw: [Decision(options="Stay focused! The revenant's shadow is trying to pull you into the darkness!;Careful! It seems like we can't harm it in any tangible way.", values="1;2")]
options: Stay focused! The revenant's shadow is trying to pull you into the darkness!;Careful! It seems like we can't harm it in any tangible way.

raw: [name="W"]Gah. That chatty bastard pisses me off even more than these clingy sons of bitches!
speaker: W
content: Gah. That chatty bastard pisses me off even more than these clingy sons of bitches!

raw: [name="W"]Keep yapping, old coot, and I'll blow your nest into bits.
speaker: W
content: Keep yapping, old coot, and I'll blow your nest into bits.

raw: [name="W"]Those black shadows are persistently protecting its core.
speaker: W
content: Those black shadows are persistently protecting its core.

raw: [name="W"]Regular bombs aren't going to do shit.
speaker: W
content: Regular bombs aren't going to do shit.

speaker: W
content: {@nickname}. It can't affect your mind.

raw: [name="W"]So you better not tell me you're out of ideas.
speaker: W
content: So you better not tell me you're out of ideas.

raw: [Decision(options="...I don't know much about revenants.;We have an expert on our side to ask for help.", values="1;2")]
options: ...I don't know much about revenants.;We have an expert on our side to ask for help.

speaker: W
content: Wait, where did Mon3tr go?

raw: [Decision(options="Keep to our original plan, and continue bombing the core cabin.;I gave it something else to do.", values="1;2")]
options: Keep to our original plan, and continue bombing the core cabin.;I gave it something else to do.

speaker: W
content: I think I figured it out.

raw: [name="W"]If that's the case, then let's make some noise in here!
speaker: W
content: If that's the case, then let's make some noise in here!

raw: [name="W"]Though I won't have time to protect you, hood.
speaker: W
content: Though I won't have time to protect you, hood.

speaker: W
content: So you better start praying.

raw: W aims her launcher up high, and the place feels increasingly dangerous with each pull of the trigger.
content: W aims her launcher up high, and the place feels increasingly dangerous with each pull of the trigger.

raw: Every inch of the dome, every pillar, everywhere...
content: Every inch of the dome, every pillar, everywhere...

raw: Explosives instantly latch onto everything you see.
content: Explosives instantly latch onto everything you see.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Futile!", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Futile!

content: The revenant roars in anger.

raw: These people are not worth his full wrath—it ought to be reserved for the origin of suffering.
content: These people are not worth his full wrath—it ought to be reserved for the origin of suffering.

raw: For it will remember his anger, and inherit his rage at the very moment he sets himself free in death.
content: For it will remember his anger, and inherit his rage at the very moment he sets himself free in death.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Get out!", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Get out!

raw: Waves of shadow surge from every nook and cranny of the cabin.
content: Waves of shadow surge from every nook and cranny of the cabin.

raw: An unending stream of shadows flow from the core and wrap around every explosive—
content: An unending stream of shadows flow from the core and wrap around every explosive—

raw: Darkness sweeps through explosions toward you.
content: Darkness sweeps through explosions toward you.

raw: Bubbles froth in the shadowy tide as blasts go off one after another, like pustules on a monster rushing in your direction.
content: Bubbles froth in the shadowy tide as blasts go off one after another, like pustules on a monster rushing in your direction.

raw: The shadow creeps right before your eyes.
content: The shadow creeps right before your eyes.

raw: You look at W. She eventually throws out her final flash grenade towards the darkness—
content: You look at W. She eventually throws out her final flash grenade towards the darkness—
Then, the shadows shroud you.

raw: [Decision(options="*sigh* I'll probably have to lie down for a few days after this.;I trust...", values="1;2")]
options: *sigh* I'll probably have to lie down for a few days after this.;I trust...

raw: A feeble light leaks through a crack in the darkness.
content: A feeble light leaks through a crack in the darkness.

raw: [Decision(options="I'm here—;I'm leaving the rest to you—", values="1;2")]
options: I'm here—;I'm leaving the rest to you—

raw: Shattered Originium fragments splash out from behind you.
content: Shattered Originium fragments splash out from behind you.

raw: A black thread immediately follows, weaving through the waves to find you.
content: A black thread immediately follows, weaving through the waves to find you.

raw: It wraps around your hand, your body...
content: It wraps around your hand, your body...

raw: And pulls you free from the shadows completely.
content: And pulls you free from the shadows completely.
Thank you for sending a signal.

speaker: Amiya
content: I finally found you, Doctor.

speaker: W
content: You're slower than I thought, bunny.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Thank you for protecting the Doctor, W.
speaker: Amiya
content: Thank you for protecting the Doctor, W.

speaker: W
content: Hmph.

speaker: Amiya
content: Please leave the rest to me.

speaker: Amiya
content: We meet again, Revenant...

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Subtitle(text="Get out of here!", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Get out of here!

raw: [Subtitle(text="Get out of my body!", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Get out of my body!

raw: Amiya captures the revenant's emotions from within the dark tides.
content: Amiya captures the revenant's emotions from within the dark tides.

raw: She sees a projection brimming with fury.
content: She sees a projection brimming with fury.

raw: The revenant condenses his emotion into a phantom lance, towering above everything.
content: The revenant condenses his emotion into a phantom lance, towering above everything.

raw: But why... is there an emotion hidden even deeper underneath his rage?
content: But why... is there an emotion hidden even deeper underneath his rage?

raw: A feeling all too familiar, one that resonates with the vanished apparitions.
content: A feeling all too familiar, one that resonates with the vanished apparitions.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Outblood King!", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Outblood King!

raw: [Subtitle(text="You, who dare to shed false tears—", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: You, who dare to shed false tears—

raw: [Subtitle(text="What makes you grieve for Sarkaz sorrows?!", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: What makes you grieve for Sarkaz sorrows?!

raw: The lance seems almost physical in the revenant's hand.
content: The lance seems almost physical in the revenant's hand.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Our mission from millennia ago shall inevitably end in my very hands.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Our mission from millennia ago shall inevitably end in my very hands.

raw: [Subtitle(text="No one will stand between us—", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: No one will stand between us—

raw: [Subtitle(text="And what we must witness—", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: And what we must witness—

raw: [Subtitle(text="The end of fate!", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: The end of fate!

raw: [name="Amiya"]My tears fall for those gone souls of Babel...
speaker: Amiya
content: My tears fall for those gone souls of Babel...

speaker: Amiya
content: And for you as well, Revenant.
Black Arts coalesces before her.

raw: [name="Amiya"]You asked me, why I wish to stop this war...
speaker: Amiya
content: You asked me, why I wish to stop this war...

speaker: Amiya
content: I have your answer now.

raw: [name="Amiya"]I've seen the path that lies ahead of us. This war shouldn't be part of the Sarkaz future—
speaker: Amiya
content: I've seen the path that lies ahead of us. This war shouldn't be part of the Sarkaz future—

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Subtitle(text="Hypocrite!", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Hypocrite!

raw: The revenant gathers all his hate, rage, and pain into his palm...
content: The revenant gathers all his hate, rage, and pain into his palm...

raw: The lance has taken physical form.
content: The lance has taken physical form.

raw: He throws his entire life towards Amiya.
content: He throws his entire life towards Amiya.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=5, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
It penetrates through a black barrier and pierces through her body.
content: It penetrates through a black barrier and pierces through her body.

raw: In an instant, a sea of complex and unbounded emotions washes over Amiya...
content: In an instant, a sea of complex and unbounded emotions washes over Amiya...

raw: She sees a blaze in the depths of a flaming forge.
content: She sees a blaze in the depths of a flaming forge.

raw: She sees a huge, headless, hollow suit of armor as it trudges against a Catastrophe, leaving an endless trail on the land as it hauls ancient sacrificial stones behind its back.
content: She sees a huge, headless, hollow suit of armor as it trudges against a Catastrophe, leaving an endless trail on the land as it hauls ancient sacrificial stones behind its back.

raw: She sees Elder Arts streaking across the horizon, smashing walls of stone into powder.
content: She sees Elder Arts streaking across the horizon, smashing walls of stone into powder.
She sees a Sarkaz.

raw: He stands with his back to a monolith. The foundation stone of his homeland, a fragment of Kazdel.
content: He stands with his back to a monolith. The foundation stone of his homeland, a fragment of Kazdel.

raw: The Sarkaz shouts toward his King:
content: The Sarkaz shouts toward his King:

raw: [Subtitle(text="Kazdel stands behind me. They will not take it.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Kazdel stands behind me. They will not take it.

raw: [Subtitle(text="If that greedy Hegemon wants this piece of land, they can come and try.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: If that greedy Hegemon wants this piece of land, they can come and try.

raw: [Subtitle(text="But O King, as you say, there is nothing they can take away but ruin.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: But O King, as you say, there is nothing they can take away but ruin.

raw: [Subtitle(text="My tears have dried, and only rage remains, pulsing in my chest.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: My tears have dried, and only rage remains, pulsing in my chest.

raw: [Subtitle(text="I will stay. I will guard this land, till death.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: I will stay. I will guard this land, till death.

raw: [Subtitle(text="This is my mission.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: This is my mission.

raw: Amiya sees the Sarkaz pointing toward the aloof Elders.
content: Amiya sees the Sarkaz pointing toward the aloof Elders.

raw: She sees the Hegemon surrounded by Elders, charging towards the group from Kazdel.
content: She sees the Hegemon surrounded by Elders, charging towards the group from Kazdel.
Shouts. Cries. Powerless gasps.

raw: [Subtitle(text="My tears have already dried, and it should be only rage that remains, pulsing in my chest...", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: My tears have already dried, and it should be only rage that remains, pulsing in my chest...

raw: [Subtitle(text="But why do I still feel pain over my people's demise?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: But why do I still feel pain over my people's demise?

raw: [Subtitle(text="O King, I will not retreat even half a step from the frontline—", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: O King, I will not retreat even half a step from the frontline—

raw: Amiya has seen it before, that cruel segment of history.
content: Amiya has seen it before, that cruel segment of history.

raw: She has seen the first King of Sarkaz ignite an unprecedented Catastrophe, and every Hegemon and their troops besieging the city disappeared that very day...
content: She has seen the first King of Sarkaz ignite an unprecedented Catastrophe, and every Hegemon and their troops besieging the city disappeared that very day...

raw: Along with that King and his loyal subjects.
content: Along with that King and his loyal subjects.

raw: [Subtitle(text="But why did the pitch-black Catastrophe that engulfed the sky disintegrate my body, while refusing to let me die?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: But why did the pitch-black Catastrophe that engulfed the sky disintegrate my body, while refusing to let me die?

raw: [Subtitle(text="That flash of light branded my figure into Kazdel's soil and rock for eternity.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: That flash of light branded my figure into Kazdel's soil and rock for eternity.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Death betrayed me, and I became an eternal shadow of my homeland.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Death betrayed me, and I became an eternal shadow of my homeland.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Your mission has already ended... That city has become a phantom from the past.
speaker: Amiya
content: Your mission has already ended... That city has become a phantom from the past.

raw: [Subtitle(text="...Ended?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: ...Ended?

raw: [Subtitle(text="No, before death returns to me, before the Sarkaz's fate is rewritten—my duty remains.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: No, before death returns to me, before the Sarkaz's fate is rewritten—my duty remains.

raw: Amiya's tears are wiped away by the storm.
content: Amiya's tears are wiped away by the storm.

raw: She sees a Sarkaz—a Sarkaz who has been lingering for nine thousand years, waiting to complete a mission.
content: She sees a Sarkaz—a Sarkaz who has been lingering for nine thousand years, waiting to complete a mission.

speaker: Amiya
content: I see it now, Revenant—

speaker: Amiya
content: Your true form.

raw: [name="Amiya"]It's true I'm not a Sarkaz, but I feel their suffering all the same first-hand.
speaker: Amiya
content: It's true I'm not a Sarkaz, but I feel their suffering all the same first-hand.

raw: [name="Amiya"]The crown I bear, and the future I'm unwilling to give up...
speaker: Amiya
content: The crown I bear, and the future I'm unwilling to give up...

raw: [name="Amiya"]I never excluded the Sarkaz for even a moment.
speaker: Amiya
content: I never excluded the Sarkaz for even a moment.

raw: [name="Amiya"]I will end all suffering. This is my answer to you!
speaker: Amiya
content: I will end all suffering. This is my answer to you!

raw: Within the infinite darkness, black threads twist around the lance running through Amiya and pulls it out of her.
